crossRefs.note: The hyrax, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

translations.web: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.
translations.bsb: the rock badgers are creatures of little power, yet they make their homes in the rocks;
translations.kjv: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
translations.asv: The conies are but a feeble folk, Yet make they their houses in the rocks;
